description: dotnet new template for a .NET 10 service with one bounded context in Clean Architecture on the Sarv framework: SQL Server or PostgreSQL by configuration, CQRS, minimal APIs, transactional outbox, local users and sign-in, permissions, settings, feature flags, audit log, multi-tenancy, caching, background jobs, observability, Docker, Kubernetes and xUnit v3 tests.
title: Clean Architecture Service Template (Sarv)
